content: लोचकः [लोच्-ण्वुल्] .²1 A stupid person. .²2 The pupil of the eye. .²3 Lamp-black, collyrium; ‘लोचको मांसपिण्डे स्यादक्षितारे च कज्जले’ इति विश्वः; <ls>Śi. 4. 35</ls>. .²4 A kind of ear-ring. .²5 A dark or blue garment. .²6 A bow string. .²7 A particular ornament worn by women on the forehead. .²8 A lump of flesh. .²9 The slough of a snake. .²10 A wrinkled skin. .²11 The wrinkled brow. .²12 A plantain tree.
